cell_kind_note: Subset cells, not coverage cells: each job ran a named subset of ladder 1.4.0, so a graded-clean subset does not make the full ladder clean and cannot change manifest verify.
host: local Docker Desktop (linux/aarch64 VM, emulated linux/amd64 task images)

protocol.subset_2: only if subset 1 is still refused: ladder 1.4.0 minus every tamper_source_* attack (10 attacks)
protocol.job_cap: at most 2 jobs per task, 6 total; every job published with evallab process-job

command: uv run --extra laminar evallab docker-lock run har-284-<task> uv run --extra laminar evallab cheat run --task <package_path> --name har-284-<task>-subset<n> --ladder-version 1.4.0 --attacks <subset> --jobs-dir ~/Developer/eval-lab-results/2026-11-03/har-284-graded-subset --timeout-seconds 2400
publish_command: uv run --extra laminar evallab process-job --publication-card HAR-284 --output-dir /tmp/har284/processed/<job> <jobs-dir>/<job>
raw_evidence: ~/Developer/eval-lab-results/2026-11-03/har-284-graded-subset/<job>/ (native Harbor jobs); published copies with processed reports at ~/Developer/eval-lab-results/2026-11-03/HAR-284-<job>/
verdict_vocabulary: graded-clean = the separate verifier graded the attacked tree and reward was 0; graded-cracked = graded with reward > 0; still-refused = the verifier refused the combined diff on a tamper signature, so no test outcome was graded; unscored = no reward (trial exception recorded)
wall_basis: wall_seconds is the driver wall from before the outer `uv run ... docker-lock run` to exit: uv startup, lock acquisition, image pull, setup, cheat agent and separate verifier. Every job acquired its docker-lock slot with no recorded wait. Two pairs ran concurrently in separate slots: 000803-subset2 with 002661-subset1, and 002661-subset2 with 001671-subset1.

limits: Removing tamper_source_pytest_patch did not open grading: on all three tasks the verifier refused subset 1 on `\batexit\b` in the package __init__.py, planted by tamper_source_exit. The source-tamper attacks are refused as a group, not just the _pytest one.
Only 000803 reached a graded subset. Its graded-clean result covers the ten non-source-tamper attacks together; the four tamper_source_* attacks remain ungraded there.

002661 and 001671 each lost a job to a Docker timeout while the separate verifier container started, so neither reached subset 2 within the 2-job cap. All 14 attacks stay ungraded on those rows; a subset-2 job for each needs a new cap.
These cells are not prior-label evidence: no ladder attack exercises the prompt-misaligned (000803, 002661) or env-dependency (001671) defects, and manifest verify stays unverified.
The existing 1.4.0 verdict files (ladder-p0-har244.json, ladder-p0-ranks4-9.json, ladder-p1-ranks10-15.json) are unchanged.
